title: A Room for the Rain
summary: You came in off the west road with wet boots and no plans beyond a dry bed.

stages.text: The road east should lead to a village. Somewhere with a roof.
stages.hint: Follow the road east from the milestone.

stages.text: Brindlecross. The building with lanterns and smoke looks like an inn.
stages.hint: The inn is the large timbered house on the west side of the square.

objectives.text: Ask about a room at the inn

stages.text: A room, a key, and advice you didn't ask for. The notice board by the hall is apparently where work turns up.
stages.hint: The notice board stands near the stone hall north of the square.

completion_text: You have a room at the Rain & Lantern for as long as you need it.
